description.en: GPU-accelerated liquid physics, canvas shaders, and interactive web elements.
description.zh: GPU 硬件加速的流体动力学物理模拟、Canvas 着色器与沉浸式交互组件。

content.en: Canvas UI pushes the boundaries of browser rendering with GPU-accelerated liquid simulations, organic shader blobs, particle fields, and interactive physics canvases. Built for creative landing pages, it gives websites a hypnotic visual identity without sacrificing FPS.
content.zh: Canvas UI 充分利用 WebGL 与 Canvas 硬件加速管线，将令人惊叹的流体动力学模拟、动态粘滞光球、粒子引力场与 Shader 滤镜封装为易于调用的 React 组件。在保障稳定高帧率的同时，赋予品牌落地页梦幻般极具张力的动态视觉标识。
